names.note: Name page of days.pravoslavie.ru for this memory is «Святитель Никодим (Кононов), епископ Белгородский, сщмч.»; the grade, the rank and, where there is one, the see are stripped and the surname kept, the day line itself giving only the forename. `fk.mjs` on the stored string returns NONE.

death.note: The day line closes «(1918)», which is the whole of what the source gives; no year of birth anywhere.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 28 декабря ст. ст. — «Сщмчч. Никодима , еп. Белгородского и Аркадия диакона (1918).»

attestations.note: THE LINE AND THE NAME PAGE ARE ALL THERE IS: no life page stands behind this entry. The line names two men, a bishop and a deacon, and both are in this draft. The line says «еп. Белгородского» and the name page «епископ Белгородский», which agree, so `bishop` and the office `Bishop of Belgorod` are the source’s own words.  The day page prints two hymns and both belong to the twenty thousand martyrs of Nicomedia; nothing stands under this name.
